description_en: Queries whether the current instance supports the Advanced Download feature
description_zh: 查询当前实例是否支持高级下载
kebab_example: aliyun dbs describe-download-support --region-code cn-hangzhou --instance-name rm-bp1a48p922r4b0000 --api-version 2021-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDownloadSupport

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26231.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 实例所在地域ID，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26231.html查询
parameters.name: region_code

parameters.help_en: The name of the sharded cluster. This parameter is required only for MongoDB sharded cluster instances
parameters.help_zh: 仅MongoDB依赖，分片集群的集群名
parameters.name: cluster_name

Data.description_en:
Indicates whether the Advanced Download feature is supported. Valid values:

true: The feature is supported.

false: The feature is not supported
Data.description_zh:
是否支持高级下载功能，返回值如下：

true：支持
false：不支持

ErrCode.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails
ErrCode.description_zh: 调用出错时返回的错误码

ErrMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrMessage.description_zh: 调用错误时返回的错误信息
ErrMessage.example: Argument: regionCode Must not be empty

Message.example: Argument: regionCode Must not be empty

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.

false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
